name: pixel-style-poster-skill
title_zh: 把主题变成 3:4 像素风海报与配套位图
tagline_zh: 给一句主题、情绪或照片，直接拿到杂志感点阵海报：大号细点主体、克制配色、低分辨率复古味，标题与留白排版也一并给到。
tagline_en: Give a theme, mood, or photo; get an editorial dot-matrix poster: fine-grained subject, restrained palette.
desc_en: Generate Pixel Style Poster prompts and matching raster images. Use when the user gives a theme, phrase, object, mood, photo, or content idea and wants a 3:4 editorial bitmap poster with a large fine dot-matrix subject, optional title-led or quiet microtype typography, close subject-text composition, optional colored-wash reverse halftone backgrounds, restrained color transitions, and low-resoluti
why_zh: 不是只给提示词——它同时渲染出位图成品，且排版与主体间距按 3:4 构图强制收紧。
why_en: Not just prompts—it renders the bitmap too, with 3:4 composition and tight subject-text spacing enforced, avoiding the usual.
limit_zh: 只认 3:4 竖版；输入需是主题/情绪/照片等可描述内容，不接受纯技术参数。输出为低分辨率位图（非矢量）。
limit_en: Only 3:4 portrait; needs a describable theme/mood/photo, not raw specs. Output is low-res bitmap (not vector); no 300dpi print files or local edits.
title_en: Turn any theme into a 3:4 pixel poster + bitmap
